fact_text: The government cut the capped diesel margin for local refineries from 41.89 dollars to 38 dollars per barrel for an initial three months, after which it will review whether to hold, cut or raise the cap.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: While the international diesel crack was running near 51.85 dollars per barrel, Pakistani refineries were capped at 38 dollars, a gap of roughly 14 dollars per barrel that accrues to consumers rather than refiners.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Diesel feeds directly into transport costs and therefore into general inflation, which is why the government compresses refinery diesel margins instead of letting international crack spreads pass through.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The draft Auto Policy 2026-31 cuts tariffs on both built-up and knocked-down vehicles towards 15% by 2030-31 to raise competition, and still needs federal cabinet and parliamentary approval.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Under the draft policy sales tax over 2026-31 is set at 1% for pure electric vehicles, 6% for range-extender electrics and 9% for plug-in hybrids, deliberately ranking technologies by electric capability.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The draft policy puts a 10% federal excise duty on expensive electric vehicles while cutting duties on cheap ones, so that affordable electrics spread while luxury imports keep paying for their foreign-exchange cost.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Federal excise duty on cars below 1000cc, both locally assembled and imported, would fall from 2.5% to zero under the draft auto policy, which favours entry-level models such as the Suzuki Alto.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: An automotive development levy on cars above 1000cc would fund the policy's export incentives, industrial development programmes and technology upgrades, so larger-engine buyers subsidise the sector's modernisation.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The draft policy targets 6 billion dollars of vehicle and parts exports, compensating exporters 5% of export value plus a further 10% for year-on-year growth, with penalties and loss of manufacturing certification for missing targets two years running.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: To lift electric vehicle adoption the government proposes raising the car financing limit from PKR 3 million to PKR 10 million and extending maximum repayment tenor from three to five years.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan's petroleum division warned that unless LNG imports began in the first week of October, winter gas shortages would force curtailment to power, fertilizer, CNG and cement users to keep supplying households.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A decision on 22 LNG cargoes, sourced mainly from the United States and Azerbaijan after Qatar declared force majeure over Strait of Hormuz disruption, was still pending with the cabinet energy committee.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When gas is short in Pakistan, industrial users - power, fertilizer, CNG and cement - are cut before residential consumers, so a winter LNG shortfall hits those sectors' output first.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: McCormick announced plans to acquire about 76.55% and control of Unilever Pakistan Foods, part of a global combination of Unilever's foods division including brands such as Knorr, expected to complete around mid-2027 subject to Pakistani approvals.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Unilever retains its personal care, beauty and home care businesses globally; only the foods division, which owns the Pakistani listed entity, is being merged with McCormick.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Attock Refinery's Q1 FY2027 net sales reached PKR 143.81 billion against PKR 59.31 billion a year earlier, with profit of PKR 18.64 billion versus PKR 1.45 billion and earnings per share of PKR 174.89 against PKR 13.62.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan Refinery reported Q1 FY2027 revenue of PKR 126.18 billion against PKR 61.66 billion a year earlier and profit of PKR 13.96 billion against PKR 1.01 billion.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: National Refinery's Q1 FY2027 revenue rose about 91% to PKR 152.3 billion while after-tax profit jumped to PKR 11.56 billion from PKR 1.02 billion, lifting earnings per share to PKR 144.68 from PKR 12.82.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistani refineries all reported order-of-magnitude profit increases in Q1 FY2027 as international crude and product prices spiked, showing how levered refinery earnings are to the oil cycle despite margin caps.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Engro Fertilizers posted Q1 FY2027 net sales of PKR 79.59 billion against PKR 54.76 billion, profit of PKR 9.12 billion against PKR 5.81 billion, earnings per share of PKR 6.83 and a dividend of PKR 5.5 per share.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: HBL recorded its highest ever quarterly profit in Q1 FY2027, with earnings per share of PKR 13.33 and a dividend of PKR 6 per share.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Nishat Chunian's Q1 FY2027 revenue was PKR 24.06 billion against PKR 22.94 billion while net profit rose to PKR 1.73 billion from PKR 56 million, and the company proposed buying back 21% of its shares.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan Telecommunication Company swung to a small net profit of about PKR 62 million in its Q1 FY2027 quarter from a PKR 1.2 billion loss a year earlier, on revenue up roughly 60%.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan, Turkiye, Qatar and Indonesia signed the Badr Defence Accord to share military technology, capability and training, which unlike the Mecca pact carries no mutual-attack clause.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst distinguishes PSX weakness driven by external shocks such as Middle East conflict and oil prices from Pakistan's own economic data, which he described as stable or improving at the time.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Draft Auto Policy, Diesel Margins, Unilever Foods | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)
